claim: Ridge Lytton Springs (650 Lytton Springs Rd, ~4 mi from Healdsburg plaza) is open daily 10am-4pm with an Estate Tasting at $35/person (complimentary for members), plus Monte Bello Cabernet Tasting at $75 and Vine to Table Pairing at $125; reservations strongly suggested, walk-ins when possible.
quote: Estate Tasting: $35 per person (complimentary for wine club members)... Monte Bello Cabernet Tasting: $75 per person... Open Daily, 10am – 4pm... 650 Lytton Springs Road, Healdsburg, CA 95448

claim: Jordan Vineyard & Winery (1474 Alexander Valley Rd) is a Bordeaux-style chateau estate requiring advance reservations; A Taste of Jordan is $55, the Winery Tour & Tasting $80, Chef's Terrace Tasting $110, and Estate Tour & Tasting $160.
quote: A Taste of Jordan $55... Winery Tour & Tasting $80... Chef's Terrace Tasting $110... Estate Tour & Tasting $160... Advance reservations are required due to the intimacy of the experiences.

claim: Dry Creek Vineyard offers daily seated tastings at roughly $30-$50 per guest with reservations encouraged; online reservations close 24 hours ahead, same-day by phone at (707) 433-1000.
quote: tastings are available daily for $30-$50 per guest with reservations encouraged. Online reservations close 24 hours in advance

claim: Preston Farm & Winery (9282 W Dry Creek Rd) is an organic/biodynamic farm with a casual rustic vibe; tastings are $35/person for 5-6 estate wines by appointment Thursday-Tuesday, with sourdough bread, olive oil, picnic grounds, bocce, and Sunday jug wine.
quote: Tastings cost $35 per person (non-refundable) and consist of a flight of 5-6 organically grown estate wines... bocce on weekdays, and jug wine on Sunday.

claim: Unti Vineyards (4202 Dry Creek Rd) is a small estate-only producer of Rhone and Italian varieties, open by appointment 7 days a week 10am-4pm for groups of 6 or fewer, sourcing all wines from 60 acres in Dry Creek Valley.
quote: The tasting room is open by appointment 7 days a week from 10am to 4pm for groups of 6 people or less. They have 60 acres of vineyards here in Dry Creek Valley, which is the sole source for all of their wines.

claim: Twomey's Russian River tasting room (3000 Westside Rd, Healdsburg) focuses on single-vineyard Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay; the Twomey Experience is $35, Single Vineyard $55, and Founders Flight $65, reservations recommended, walk-ins for parties of 4 or fewer.
quote: Twomey Experience: $35/person... Twomey Single Vineyard: $55/person – Four single-vineyard Pinot Noirs... The Founders Flight: $65/person... Reservations are recommended to guarantee your preferred tasting.

claim: Gary Farrell Vineyards (10701 Westside Rd) sits atop a ridge with sweeping Russian River Valley views and acclaimed Pinot Noir/Chardonnay; tastings range from a $15 Daily Tasting and $25 Terrace Tasting to the $45 Elevation Tasting and $65 Exploration Tour, reservations required.
quote: Perched atop a ridge along winding Westside Road, the winery offers a spectacular view... Daily Tasting - $15... Terrace Tasting... $25... Elevation Tasting - $45... Reservations are required

claim: Williamson Wines (18 Matheson St) is an on-the-plaza walkable tasting room known for guided wine-and-artisanal-cheese/food pairings led by in-house chefs, with an Icon Wine & Food Pairing at $50/person spanning Cabernet, Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.
quote: The Icon Wine & Food Pairing Experience... Priced at $50 per person and lasting approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes... sample four wines including cabernet sauvignon, sauvignon blanc, chardonnay, and pinot noir.

claim: Ferrari-Carano (8761 Dry Creek Rd) is a grand estate famed for five acres of landscaped gardens with 100-year-old olive trees and Fontana Pergolas; tastings are by appointment with walk-ins subject to availability, and the Reserve experience needs 48-hour advance booking.
quote: The winery is home to five acres of award-winning gardens and breathtaking vineyard views... open by appointment for wine tasting experiences, and walk-ins are welcome based on availability. The Reserve experience requires 48-hour advance reservation.

claim: Truett-Hurst (5610 Dry Creek Rd) is a biodynamic/organic estate set on Dry Creek itself with 26 acres (15 of Zinfandel and Petite Sirah) and a relaxed creekside tasting setting.
quote: Their tasting room is near the babbling Dry Creek, with splendid views... They have 26 acres with 15 acres of Zinfandel and Petite Sirah planted... biodynamic and organic farming methods set it apart

claim: Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve sits 3 miles north of Guerneville on Armstrong Woods Road, charges $10 per vehicle ($9 seniors), is free to pedestrians and cyclists, and protects old-growth coast redwoods.
quote: Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve allows visitors to experience the beauty of the coast redwood (Sequoia sempervirens).

claim: Armstrong Redwoods has 9.2 miles of trails; the Pioneer Nature Trail is a 1.5-mile round-trip, mostly flat and ADA-accessible, and limited free parking is available along Armstrong Woods Road or by walking in from the entrance lot.
quote: Admission is $10 per vehicle, $9 per vehicle for seniors and free to pedestrians and cyclists. Limited free parking is available along Armstrong Redwoods Road on the west side of the road only.

claim: Lake Sonoma is a 17,615-acre park 13 miles northwest of Healdsburg with more than 40 miles of trails for hikers, equestrians and mountain bikers, plus boating, swimming, fishing, a disc golf course and a year-round Visitor Center and Fish Hatchery.
quote: More than 40 miles of trails welcome hikers, horseback riders and mountain bikers to Lake Sonoma, a 17,615 acre park 13 miles northwest of Healdsburg.

claim: Lake Sonoma trail options include the Woodland Ridge Nature Trail with Dry Creek Valley views, the moderate 4.3-mile Dry Creek and Bummer Trail Loop, and the challenging North Slope to Bummer Peak Loop.
quote: The moderate 4.3-mile Dry Creek and Bummer Trail Loop, featuring varied terrain and panoramic views.

claim: Riverfront Regional Park (7821 Eastside Road, Healdsburg) offers 3.12 miles of trails including the 2.18-mile Lake Trail around Lake Benoist and a half-mile Redwood Hill Trail through a coast redwood grove; dogs allowed on leash; parking $8 fall/winter/spring and $12 summer; open 7am to sunset.
quote: The park offers 3.12 miles of trails total. The main Lake Trail spans 2.18 miles and circles Lake Benoist, while the Redwood Hill Trail covers half a mile through a coastal redwood forest.

claim: Healdsburg Ridge Open Space Preserve is 155 acres of oak woodlands, wetlands, serpentine chaparral and grasslands with roughly 2-3 miles of easy-to-moderate trails, dogs allowed on leash, but only residential street parking and no restrooms.
quote: Healdsburg Ridge Open Space Preserve is 155 acres of oak woodlands, wetlands, rocky serpentine chaparral, and open grasslands.

claim: Foothill Regional Park (1351 Arata Lane, Windsor) is 211 acres with nearly 7 miles of multi-use trails ranging from the challenging Alta Vista Trail to the wheelchair-accessible Three Lakes Trail, three fishing ponds, $8 parking, and dogs allowed on leash.
quote: The park maintains nearly 7 miles of pathways. Trail options range from challenging terrain like Alta Vista Trail to easier routes such as the Three Lakes Trail, which is wheelchair-accessible.

claim: Shiloh Ranch Regional Park (5750 Faught Road, Windsor) is an 850-acre Mayacamas-foothills park with nearly 8 miles of moderate looped multi-use trails and $8 parking, but dogs are prohibited on trails (allowed only in picnic areas and parking lot).
quote: Nearly 8 miles of looped trails accommodate hiking, biking, and horseback riding... Dogs on leash are prohibited from trails but permitted in picnic areas and the parking lot.

claim: Russian River Adventures runs a self-guided 9-mile inflatable-canoe trip from Memorial Beach (Larry's Launch) to Wohler Bridge, 2.5-4 hrs in spring and 3.5-6 hrs in summer, with advance online reservations and 9:30-10:30 AM check-in.
quote: Larry's Launch to Wohler Bridge ... Distance: 9 miles ... Duration: 2.5–4 hours (spring); 3.5–6 hours (summer) ... Check-In: 9:30 AM – 10:30 AM ... Advance online reservations required

claim: Russian River Adventures (33 Healdsburg Ave Ste P) charges $80 adults (13+), $40 kids (12 and under), $15 dogs for 2026, with a group rate of $67.50/person for parties of 10+ adults.
quote: Adults (13 and up) are $80, Kids (12 and under) are $40, and Dogs are $15 ... Groups of 10 or more adults qualify for a group discount, and the group rate is $67.50 per person.

claim: River's Edge Kayak & Canoe launches at Healdsburg next to the bridge across from Veterans Memorial Beach, offering a 2-hour 5-mile Rio Trip (from $171.20), a 2-hour Sunset Paddle (from $107), and a 9-hour Class-2 Alex Trip from Alexander Valley (from $212.93); open Thu-Sun 8am-4pm.
quote: The Rio Trip ... From $171.20 ... 2 hours ... 5-mile stretch ... The Alex Trip – Class 2 ... From $212.93 ... 9 hours ... Sunset Evening Paddle ... From $107 ... Thursday - Sunday, 8 am - 4 pm PDT

claim: Burke's Canoe Trips in Forestville opens for 2026 on Memorial weekend (May 22 camping, May 23 canoes) through mid-October, offering a self-guided 10-mile Forestville-to-Guerneville trip of roughly 3.5 hours' paddling (often 4-5 hours total) through the redwoods.
quote: open for the 2026 summer season beginning Memorial weekend on Friday, May 22nd for camping and Saturday, May 23rd for canoe/kayaks ... ten mile self-guided canoe/kayak trip ... from Forestville to ... Guerneville ... approximately 3 ½ hours, actual canoeing time

claim: At Healdsburg Veterans Memorial Beach a seasonal dam (installation completed by July 3, 2026) creates a calm swimming lagoon from July through Labor Day; lifeguards staff Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day, parking is $12, free loaner life vests are available, and dogs cannot access the beach or river.
quote: The temporary dam operates from July through Labor Day ... The summer dam installation will be completed by July 3 ... staffed with lifeguards from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day ... Summer rate: $12 ... Free loaner life vests are available ... dogs cannot access the beach or river

claim: The recommended tubing route is the 2-mile Steelhead Beach to Sunset Beach float in Forestville (about 4.5 hours travel time); the Regional Parks River Shuttle runs every 30 min, 9am-6pm weekends/holidays Memorial Day through Labor Day 2026, costing $5 all-day with youth 18 and under free, and parking at both beaches is $12 (May 23-Sept 7).
quote: 2-mile stretch from Steelhead Beach to Sunset Beach ... about 4.5 hours ... runs every 30 minutes between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. on weekends and holidays from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. An all-day ticket is $5, and youth 18 and younger ride free ... parking fee at Sunset Beach and Steelhead Beach is $12 from May 23 through September 7

claim: Russian River Tubes & Kayaks rents tubes (book online) for the ~2-mile Steelhead-to-Sunset float (about 2.5-3 hours), using the Regional Parks shuttle for the return; its Steelhead location runs weekends/holidays 9am-2pm until Labor Day and a Healdsburg location runs June 13-Aug 31.
quote: Pick up tubes at Steelhead Beach, drop off at Sunset Beach ... approximately 2 miles and takes about 2.5-3 hours ... Regional Parks provides a shuttle ... Healdsburg location runs from June 13th till August 31st

claim: Steelhead Beach Regional Park in Forestville allows year-round launching of canoes, kayaks and paddleboards, has free life-jacket loaner stations, and prohibits alcohol/open containers from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day.
quote: Canoes, kayaks and paddleboards can be launched from the beach year-round ... Free life jacket loaner stations are available at Steelhead Beach ... Alcohol consumption and possession of open containers is prohibited ... from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day

claim: In 2026 the Healdsburg Farmers Market runs Saturdays Apr 11-Dec 19 (8:30am-12pm) and Tuesdays May 12-Sep 29 (9am-1pm) at the new Foley Family Community Pavilion, 3 North Street, a short walk from the Plaza.
quote: Saturday Market: April 11 - December 19, 8:30AM - 12PM. Tuesday Market: May 12 - September 29, 9AM - 1PM. Location: Foley Family Community Pavilion, 3 North Street, Healdsburg, CA 95448

claim: Healdsburg Plaza is ringed by unique shops, art galleries, and about 26 downtown wine tasting rooms (92 of Sonoma County's wineries are within Healdsburg city limits), making it the walkable heart of town.
quote: Of Sonoma County's 425 wineries, 92 are set within Healdsburg city limits, and 26 have wine tasting rooms right downtown.

claim: The Healdsburg Center for the Arts (334 Center St) hosts rotating exhibitions and the 2026 Healdsburg Arts Festival on Saturday Sept 26, 2026, featuring 30+ local artists, music, kids' workshops, food and wine.
quote: The HCA 2026 Arts Festival will take place on Saturday, September 26th and will include a day of local art for sale with over 30 participating artists, music, art workshops for children, a raffle, food, and good wine.

claim: The Healdsburg Museum & Historical Society, in the historic Carnegie Library at 221 Matheson St, offers free admission with a gallery open Wed-Sun 11am-4pm.
quote: Location: 221 Matheson Street... Hours: Gallery: Wed-Sun 11am-4pm... Free admission for changing exhibits

claim: Geyserville, about 8 miles (roughly 9-15 min drive) north of Healdsburg, has a compact historic downtown with boutiques, antique shops, art galleries and tasting rooms such as Locals Tasting Room (representing about a dozen small wineries) near Diavola Pizzeria.
quote: The distance between Geyserville and Healdsburg is 8 miles... It takes approximately 9 minutes to drive... Locals Tasting Room represents about a dozen small wineries... located near Diavola Pizzeria.

claim: Windsor Town Green is a family-friendly civic plaza hosting the 24th Annual Summer Nights on the Green free concert series in 2026 plus festivals, movie nights and a seasonal farmers market.
quote: The 24th Annual Summer Nights on the Green Concerts are being presented by the Town of Windsor and the Windsor Farmers Market.

claim: The Charles M. Schulz Museum (2301 Hardies Lane, Santa Rosa, ~15 mi south of Healdsburg) is open Mon & Wed-Fri 11am-5pm, Sat-Sun 10am-5pm (closed Tue); admission is $15 adults, $10 seniors 62+, $7 youth 4-18, free under 3 and members.
quote: Adults: $15; Seniors (62+): $10; Youth (4-18): $7; Members: Free; Children 3 and under: Free... Tuesday: Closed; Wednesday-Friday: 11:00 am-5:00 pm; Saturday-Sunday: 10:00 am-5:00 pm

claim: Luther Burbank Home & Gardens (204 Santa Rosa Ave) keeps the gardens free and open daily 8am-dusk; drop-in guided home/greenhouse tours run April-October and cost $12 ($10 students/seniors, under 12 free).
quote: The gardens are open free to the public daily. There are guided tours ($12, $10.00 students/seniors, under 12 free)... Drop-in guided tours are offered April - October, Tuesday - Saturday

claim: Santa Rosa's Historic Railroad Square (~15 mi / ~16 min south of Healdsburg) is a National-Register walkable district packed with antique and vintage shops, cafes and international dining.
quote: Historic Railroad Square offers visitors a walkable, family-friendly atmosphere full of international dining, vintage shopping, award winning theater and more.

claim: The driving distance from Santa Rosa to Healdsburg is about 15 miles (24 km), roughly a 16-minute drive, keeping all Santa Rosa attractions within the 30 km radius of SingleThread.
quote: The total driving distance from Santa Rosa, CA to Healdsburg, CA is 15 miles or 24 kilometers. Santa Rosa and Healdsburg are 16 minutes far apart, if you drive non-stop.

claim: Quail and Condor (149 Healdsburg Ave) was named by the NYT among 22 best US bakeries; owner Melissa Yanc previously worked at SingleThread, known for sourdough, chocolate Champagne cakes, open daily 8am-3pm.
quote: The bread program here stands out... Melissa Yanc's experience at prestigious establishments including Bien Cuit in New York, Gjusta in Los Angeles, and SingleThread in Healdsburg... open daily from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m.

claim: Downtown Bakery & Creamery is a longstanding Healdsburg Plaza bakery, a casual breakfast/pastry stop.
quote: Downtown Bakery and Creamery

claim: Russian River Brewing's Windsor pub (700 Mitchell Ln) is the larger of its two locations with free parking, expanded menu, and guided brewery tour; makes Pliny the Elder, with Pliny the Younger released only in February.
quote: Windsor Brewery & Pub - Russian River Brewing Company

claim: Russian River Brewing Co. is famed for IPAs and sours, flagship Pliny the Elder created by Vinnie Cilurzo; Windsor facility opened October 2018 differentiated by larger size, free parking and tours; original Healdsburg Bear Republic brewpub now closed.
quote: famous for its Pliny the Elder and Pliny The Younger... The Windsor facility is differentiated from the Santa Rosa location by its larger size, free parking, expanded menu, and guided brewery tour.

claim: Geyserville (about 10 min north of Healdsburg) food stops: Diavola Pizzeria & Salumeria ($$, wood-fired pizza/cured meats, 21021 Geyserville Ave), Catelli's ($$-$$$, third-gen family Italian, handmade ravioli, 21047 Geyserville Ave), plus Rustic at Coppola Winery and Michelin-starred Cyrus.
quote: Diavola Pizzeria & Salumeria... 'The Bee Sting' pizza, handmade dough and cured meats, wood-fired oven... Catelli's... Third-generation family Italian restaurant, handmade ravioli, signature lasagna... 21047 Geyserville Avenue

claim: Acclaimed Healdsburg restaurants beyond SingleThread include Valette (modern American by chef Dustin Valette), Barndiva (garden-to-table with art gallery), and Bravas Bar de Tapas (Spanish tapas).
quote: Valette - Modern American, ingredient-driven... Barndiva - Garden-to-table with art gallery... Bravas Bar de Tapas - Spanish tapas with sangria

claim: Dry Creek General Store (est. 1881, 3495 Dry Creek Rd) is a historic deli for hand-crafted sandwiches, soups and salads, open 7am-5pm with a bar, a popular Dry Creek Valley wine-country lunch stop.
quote: Established in 1881, the Dry Creek General Store offers a unique selection of delicious foods and gifts... deli serves hand crafted sandwiches, soups, salads, and seasonal specials. They are open Sunday through Thursday: 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.

claim: Journeyman Meat Co. (404 Center St, Healdsburg) is a butcher/salumeria and tasting spot for cured meats and wine, open Wed-Sun 11am-7pm.
quote: Journeyman Meat Co. is located at 404 Center St, Healdsburg, CA 95448... Wednesday-Friday 11:00 am - 7:00 pm, and Saturday-Sunday 11:00 am - 7:00 pm

claim: The historic Jimtown Store (6706 CA-128, Alexander Valley, landmark since 1895) reopened as 'Jimtown and Then Sum' under Michelle Wood, serving dumplings, bao, banh mi and traditional deli sandwiches after closing nearly four years earlier.
quote: Jimtown Store... has been a landmark since 1895... now has a new tenant: a dim sum spot and deli called Jimtown and Then Sum... lunch menu features steamed dumplings, spring rolls, bao buns... along with traditional deli sandwiches

claim: Noble Folk Ice Cream and Pie Bar (116 Matheson St, off Healdsburg Plaza) has been Healdsburg's premier ice cream maker since 2010, known for creative ice cream and house-baked pies.
quote: Noble Folk has been Healdsburg's premier ice cream maker since 2010... creative ice cream and house-baked pies... 116 Matheson St, Healdsburg

claim: Willi's Seafood & Raw Bar on the Healdsburg Plaza is the town's go-to oyster/raw bar, with a rotating raw bar of at least eight varieties of fresh oysters paired with white wine.
quote: Willi's Seafood & Raw Bar is located in the main square downtown... the ultimate place for fresh oysters... an ever-changing selection of fresh seafood, including at least eight varieties of fresh oysters

claim: Costeaux French Bakery & Cafe is a historic Healdsburg bakery serving French pastries and made-to-order bistro breakfast/lunch daily, known for its deep-dish quiche.
quote: Costeaux Bakery brings French influence to Healdsburg... serves made-to-order bistro cuisine for breakfast and lunch every day

claim: Wine Country Bikes (402 Moore Ln, Healdsburg) rents Specialized hybrids at $49/day, Sirrus lightweight hybrids $59, Allez road bikes $79, Cervelo carbon road bikes $99, and e-bikes at $75/day, open 7 days 10am-5pm.
quote: Specialized Hybrids (Pedal): $49/day ... Specialized Allez Road Bikes: $79/day ... Cervelo Soloist Carbon Fiber Road Bikes: $99/day ... E-Bikes: $75/day ... Located at 402 Moore Ln in Healdsburg

claim: Spoke Folk Cyclery (201 Center St, Healdsburg, est. 1976) is a full-service shop renting road, e-bikes and hybrid bikes; reservations are confirmed by phone (707-433-7171) with a credit card and cancellations require 48 hours notice.
quote: Spoke Folk Cyclery in Healdsburg was established in 1976 ... They rent road bikes, e-bikes and casual hybrid bikes ... Cancellations must be made via telephone 707.433.7171 and must be made prior to 48 hours before the start of the rental period.

claim: The West Dry Creek Road - Dry Creek Road loop from Healdsburg is a 23.7-mile intermediate ride with 650 ft of climbing, roughly 2h16m, considered one of the most scenic cycling routes in Sonoma County.
quote: 23.7-mile intermediate bike ride with 650 feet of elevation gain that takes about 2 hours and 16 minutes ... West Dry Creek Road is probably the most popular cycling road in the area

claim: The Russian River Valley Loop (Westside/Eastside Roads) is a 22.8-mile route from Healdsburg down the eastside and back up the westside of the Russian River wine region, with an optional ~21-mile extension.
quote: The Russian River Valley Loop is 22.8 miles ... travels down the eastside and back up the westside of the Russian River Valley Wine Region ... For a longer route (another 21 miles)

claim: Private Wine Drivers offers private guided wine tours for up to six guests from $645 to $845 for a 6-hour journey, so guests can taste without driving.
quote: Private Wine Drivers offers various vehicle options ranging from $645 to $845 for up to 6 hours

claim: Platypus Tours runs join-in North Sonoma/Russian River/Healdsburg group wine tours at $129 per person Fridays and $139 Saturdays, including a picnic lunch; winery tasting fees (~$20-25) are extra.
quote: Platypus Tours offers join-in wine tours priced at $129 per person on Fridays and $139 per person on Saturdays ... all join-in wine tours include a tasty picnic lunch

claim: Healdsburg to Guerneville is 18 miles, about a 28-minute drive; Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve sits 3 miles further north on Armstrong Woods Road.
quote: The driving distance between Healdsburg to Guerneville is 18 miles ... approximately 28 min

claim: Lake Sonoma's Milt Brandt Visitor Center is about 11 miles west of Healdsburg via Dry Creek Road, roughly a 19-minute drive.
quote: the visitor center is 11 miles from Healdsburg when traveling west on Dry Creek Road ... approximately 19 minutes

claim: The town of Sonoma is about 36 miles / ~50 minutes from Healdsburg, beyond the 30 km radius but a common reference point.
quote: The driving distance between Sonoma to Healdsburg is 36 miles, and it takes approximately 50 min

claim: Downtown Healdsburg has several free city-owned parking lots (including a 300+ stall lot at West Plaza Park, Lot A) plus time-limited free street parking; free public parking sits across from the Farmers' Market off Matheson or North Street.
quote: There are a number of free City-owned parking lots in the downtown area ... The city lot at West Plaza Park, Lot A, which has over 300 stalls for free

claim: A private AirGarage-operated paid lot behind The Matheson charges $3.50/hour, while adjacent city Lot E remains free for up to 3 hours; paid parking is private, not city-wide.
quote: paid parking came to Healdsburg through a private lot operated by AirGarage behind The Matheson ... Rate: $3.50 per hour ... Lot E ... Free for up to 3 hours

claim: SingleThread bookings open at 9am PST on the 1st of each month for the following month, require full prepayment via OpenTable, are non-refundable but transferable, and the 10-course tasting needs a minimum 2.5 hours; online parties up to 6.
quote: Bookings open at 9am PST on the 1st of each month for the following month ... Your reservation is only confirmed with a prepayment in full via OpenTable ... Plan for a minimum of 2.5 hours for the 10-course tasting experience.

claim: SingleThread dinner service on Saturday runs roughly 4:00pm-8:45pm, so a Saturday evening seating is part of a single nightly dinner window.
quote: The restaurant is open Saturday from 4:00 pm - 8:45 pm

claim: SingleThread's Kaiseki-inspired ten-course tasting menu runs around $485 per person (per 2024 reviews), with optional wine pairings at roughly $300, $500 and $1500.
quote: The tasting menu price is approximately $485 per person ... wine pairings are available at price points of $300, $500 and $1500

claim: SingleThread publishes an official Scenic Drives guide pointing guests to nearby day-trip drives including Dry Creek Valley, Russian River and Alexander Valley.
quote: Scenic Drives - Single Thread Farms
